citation.authors: Sarswathi TR, Kumar SN, Kavitha KM

record.population: 41 tobacco users and 8 controls in India
record.design: Clinical and tissue study of mouth and lip pigmentation
record.finding: In smokers, 95.24% had pigmentation of the lip and cheek lining, the lip more (81%) than the cheek (33.3%), with more melanocytes on tissue examination. Pigmentation was absent at the site where smokeless tobacco was held.
record.note: Small, with few controls; an association; not a Black population.
